publicationDateBasis: Dated original HTML and PDF press release, September 15, 2026.

question: If the provincial election were held today, which party’s candidate would you vote for in your constituency?

marginOfError.note: Publisher reports +/-3.7 points full sample and +/-3.9 decided, nineteen times out of twenty. Online recruitment design is not specified; these reported margins are preserved here but not treated as verified probability-sampling margins.

notes: Decided voters base 613 is explicitly stated in the original release; no leaning follow-up specified.
